meta_description:
8,233 likes, 69 comments - nawabnabeel on September 21, 2026: "Good News

iCloud+ subscribers in India can now gain access to Apple TV and Apple Arcade as part of their iCloud+ subscription — at no additional cost.

The expanded subscription lets users back up, store, and share personal content across all their Apple devices using iCloud, while also enjoying award-winning originals from Apple TV and hundreds of hit games in Apple Arcade. With Family Sharing, users can share their iCloud+ subscription with up to five family members.

iCloud+ subscriptions in India is available starting at INR 75 per month for the 50GB plan. Users can choose additional storage tiers to fit their needs.".
